job_to_be_done: Translate a short text string into a target language using MyMemory so the agent can rewrite user-provided content across languages.
summary_for_model: Translates a single text string with MyMemory Translation API. Caller supplies `target_lang` (e.g. en, ja, fr, de). `source_lang` defaults to en. Returns translated text plus provenance fields.
trigger_conditions: The agent needs to translate text from one language to another.
The owner provides text and a target language code (e.g. EN, JA, FR, DE).
The agent is processing multilingual content and needs a specific language output.
The owner asks to convert document or UI strings into a target language.
usage_hints: Use target_lang codes like 'en', 'ja', 'fr', 'de' (ISO-like language codes expected by MyMemory).
If source_lang is not provided, it defaults to 'en'.
For large texts, split into chunks under 5000 characters for best results.
result_hints: Return the translated_text field directly to the owner.
Include source_lang and target_lang in the response summary so the owner knows what was used.
If translation confidence is low, flag it in the summary.
error_hints: If target_lang is unsupported, ask the owner for an ISO-like language code supported by MyMemory (e.g. 'en', 'ja').
If text is empty or whitespace only, return a validation error before calling MyMemory.
do_not_use_when: The user is asking for cultural/idiomatic rewriting rather than a translation (use a writing tool instead).
The text contains sensitive secrets (API keys, passwords).

target_lang.description: Target language code (ISO-like, e.g. en, ja, fr, de).

source_lang.description: Source language code (ISO-like). Defaults to 'en' when omitted.

preserve_formatting.description: Unused by MyMemory; accepted for compatibility but ignored.

split_sentences.description: Unused by MyMemory; accepted for compatibility but ignored.

formality.description: Unused by MyMemory; accepted for compatibility but ignored.

summary.description: One-line summary of the translation performed.

source_lang.description: Source language code used for translation.

target_lang.description: Target language code used for translation.

source.description: Human-readable upstream source label (MyMemory Translation API).

source_url.description: Canonical MyMemory endpoint URL for citation.

fetched_at.description: ISO timestamp for when this translation was performed.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds (0 for this adapter).

attribution.description: Attribution string for the upstream provider.

notes_for_model: Use this tool only for translation. Keep the user’s intent and tone; do not add new information.
If the user wants localization (tone change, marketing rewrite), ask whether to adapt style rather than literal translation.
common_errors: `invalid_input` — missing `text` or `target_lang`, or invalid option types.
